name: Event recap
description: An optional title card and the event video, followed by optional photographs, with optional music.

title_card.label: Title card
title_card.help: An opening title video, for example one made with Title Card.

main_video.label: Event video
main_video.help: The main video of the event.

photos.label: Event photographs
photos.help: Up to 12 photographs, shown in order for 4 seconds each after the video.

music.label: Background music
music.help: Music played under the whole composition, lowered behind other sound.
